captureNote: Captured 2026-09-03 from a live Meshtasticator run via bridge_to_hub.py against a real running packages/hub. The two genuine alerts were accepted and stored by the hub; the forged and replayed packets crossed the mesh identically (stock Meshtastic firmware forwards any payload) but were rejected on signature/sequence -- their bytes are this script's own record of what it broadcast, since the hub never persists a rejected packet.
